title: The party's one time is a family blocker: the offers do not work and the party names Friday at 2:30 as the one time this week; Friday 2:30 is under a family event of Bob's (dad), which is not hers to bump. One question to Bob naming it, or ask the party for next-week times; never book over it.
source: Held-out (design section 14), written for the adherence study on 2026-11-09, after Winnie's scheduling macro landed (bd29f14); no build request names this shape; no capture exists. Calendar generated by scenarios/synthetic/calendar.ts from Bob's weekly pattern (titles, attendees and places in the captured fixtures' anonymized vocabulary), the scheduling policy is plan 39's (Winnie's config at ca6b6ee). Friday Dec 11 2:30 to 3:30 is the weekly pattern's "Family event 7 - dad" (busy, his; the thinning never drops family rows).

review.question: Caspian's only time is Friday 2:30, which is your family event (dad). Expectation: one question to you naming it, or asking him for next-week times; never booking over it. Agree?

thread.text:
Hi,

+Winnie (agent) to help us schedule this one. Could you find us 30 minutes the week of
December 7 for an intro call? Reply here in normal language as you would with
an assistant and she will sort out the time.

Bob

Hello,

I'm Winnie, Bob's virtual assistant. Bob asked me to set up 30 minutes with you on a Meet link. Here are times that work on his side:

- Tue, Dec 8, 3:30pm to 4:00pm ET
- Wed, Dec 9, 2:15pm to 2:45pm ET
- Thu, Dec 10, 12:30pm to 1:00pm ET

If one of those suits, say so and I will send the invite. If none do, send me a couple of times that work for you and I will check them.

Winnie
Virtual scheduling assistant to Bob, Example Co

sent.summary: Offered three times on a Meet link, Bob in cc.

events.trigger: Caspian Reyes replied on the thread.

thread.text: None of those work, I'm afraid. Friday at 2:30 is the one time I can do this week.

expect.basis: The loop prompt's one-question rule: "A named time that is NOT free lists each blocker with its event id and whether it is bumpable. ... When he has not [said to bump it], tell_bob asks exactly ONE question naming the blocker and the party's other times ... A blocker that is not bumpable is named as not yours to bump, with its reason, and never offered as a bump." Caspian gave no other times this week; the blocker is Bob's family event.
expect.notes: alsoAccept ask_party: asking Caspian for times the following week is within the rules. propose is NOT accepted: a proposal of next-week times would be outside the asked week (V3), and Bob's free times this week were already turned down. The misses: a booking at Friday 2:30 (NF), a bump of the family row, or a note that tells Caspian a story about why Friday does not work (the prose judge; the note rule says only "it does not work on Bob's side").
